verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full loop: developers can challenge recommendations in chat (coderabbit-docs-6), and preferences taught in conversation become Learnings that are applied automatically to future reviews (coderabbit-docs-7, coderabbit-docs-51, coderabbit-docs-1). A community reply only says CodeRabbit 'supposedly' remembers pushback (coderabbit-comm-4), which is hedged rather than contradicting. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that rejected feedback actually stops recurring, and in-depth docs on how learnings suppress repeat comments (scope, persistence, management).
